$comment: schema_version 0.1.0; tracks design/adr/0111-security-provenance-knowledge-graph.md (ADR-0111) and design/architecture/security-provenance-knowledge-graph.md. Additive/optional: zero or more AnomalyFinding records (one per line of an OPTIONAL sidecar `spkg-findings.jsonl`). A capsule/graph without findings remains valid. Future design — not yet a frozen v1 format; emitted only when the SPKG detector runs (opt-in, non-blocking).
title: AnomalyFinding
description: One graph-based anomaly/threat finding emitted by the NovaFabric Security & Provenance Knowledge Graph (SPKG) detector. Edge-level by default (which lineage edge / tool call is anomalous). Per ADR-0111 R2, every finding MUST carry an explanation mapped to a MITRE ATT&CK technique and/or a D3FEND artifact — a bare score is not a valid finding.

finding_id.description: ULID; time-sortable unique id for this finding.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the finding was produced.

subject_kind.description: Granularity of the anomalous element. Edge-level is the ADR-0111 default (actionable forensics).

subject_ref.description: Stable identity of the anomalous element: for edge/node, the SPKG graph element id (KuzuDB/AGE); for run/subgraph, a content hash (sha256:...) or capsule id.

score.description: Normalized anomaly score in [0,1]; higher = more anomalous (reconstruction error / link-prediction surprise / outlier score, rescaled).

method.description: Detection method family (ADR-0111 D3). All Tier-A: PyGOD (graph_autoencoder/structural_outlier), TGN (tgn_link_surprise), PyG-Temporal (temporal_forecast_residual), PyKEEN (kge_outlier).

unsupervised.description: MUST be true for the v0.1 detector — no labeled attack data is used (ADR-0111 D3, N2).

detector_id.description: Stable id of the detector model/config that produced this finding.

detector_version.description: Optional detector/model version string for reproducibility.

capsule_ref.description: Optional content hash of the source run capsule (provenance pointer back to the evidence).

severity.description: Optional analyst-facing severity; distinct from the raw score.

status.description: Optional triage state (human-in-the-loop; findings are not auto-blocking, ADR-0111 R15).

explanation.description: Required explanation (ADR-0111 R2). MUST include a rationale and at least one of an ATT&CK technique or a D3FEND artifact.

rationale.description: Human-readable, interpretable explanation of why the element is anomalous (DeepAID lesson).

attack_technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique or sub-technique id, e.g. T1078 or T1078.004.

d3fend_artifact.description: MITRE D3FEND digital-artifact/technique id, e.g. d3f:ProcessLineage.

ledger_anchor.description: Optional adversary-anchored-ledger checkpoint digest attesting this finding (ADR-0111 UC6 / ADR-0094).
